_comment: Policy of tools/sim/sim_audit.py. excluded: the REVIEWED list of translation units that are not simulation code (glob relative to engine/, or <build>/... for generated and staged sources, with the reason); every other source must be in OPENBFME_SIM_SOURCES. facade_files / facade_functions: the registered facade implementations where floating arithmetic and math calls are the implementation (pinned by tools/sim/test_sim_audit.py).

excluded.reason: Create-a-Hero client profile statistics file IO; never simulation state

the vendored fast_float parser behind Common/FloatFromChars.h (decimal text to float / double, correctly rounded; no simulation arithmetic of ours); it is compiled with the simulation flags, and tools/sim/compare_float_chars.cpp checks it against the C++ library; libclang 18 cannot parse its SSE2 header (the reason it is the only file that includes the vendored headers)
lane ONLINE-2: host-only integer transport framing, fragmentation, CRC and bounded sequence bookkeeping; it carries opaque relay bytes and is not simulation state or simulation arithmetic
lane ONLINE-2: host-only integer canonical frame budgeting and OBFB byte codec; it carries opaque relay bytes and is not simulation state or simulation arithmetic

ANTICHEAT-1's offline fog check: runs beside replay playback and only READS the simulation's state (object positions, the shroud) to report orders on objects the ordering player could not see; it never writes simulation state, sends no command and feeds nothing back (test_orders_into_fog: the state hash with and without the check is identical). Its findings are server-side reports, not game state, so they need no cross-machine determinism

ANTICHEAT-1's D5 input rate and D6 command integrity checks: run beside replay playback (the same driver as OrdersIntoFog) and only READ the replay's commands and the simulation's object ownership to count commands per 5 s window and report malformed or foreign-object commands; they never write simulation state, send no command and feed nothing back (test_orders_into_fog_retail: playback through FogCheckDriver with them reproduces every recorded hash). Their findings are server-side reports, not game state

ANTICHEAT-1's D2 view focus check: runs beside replay playback and only READS the replay's client-reported VIEW records (camera / pointer, never simulation input) and the simulation's object positions and shroud to report a pointer resting on hidden enemies; it never writes simulation state, sends no command and feeds nothing back (test_orders_into_fog_retail: playback through FogCheckDriver with it reproduces every recorded hash). Its floats are report data, not game state
